\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{மீட்பு} (mīṭpu)}{மீட்பு (mīṭpu)}]{\ta{மீட்பு} (mīṭpu) — a rescue}

\label{lesson:TA-C301-mitpu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for to fall apart, then the Tamil for to collapse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{மீட்பு}}
\textbf{\ta{மீட்பு}} — \emph{mīṭpu} — \textquotedblleft{}a rescue\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ta{ஒருவேளை} \ta{படகு} \ta{மூழ்கினால்}, \ta{மீட்புக்} \ta{குழு} \ta{தயாராக} \ta{இருக்கிறது}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{oruvēḷai paṭaku mūḻkiṉāl, mīṭpuk kuḻu tayārāka irukkiṟatu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Should the boat sink, the rescue team is ready.
\end{quote}

Before a noun the stop doubles: \ta{மீட்புக்} \ta{குழு}, a rescue team.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{மீட்பு}} (\emph{mīṭpu}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 4883 gives it under \ta{மீள்}, \textquotedblleft{}to return, be rescued\textquotedblright{}, with the sense \textquotedblleft{}releasing, redeeming\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mīṭpu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mīṭpu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{oruvēḷai paṭaku mūḻkiṉāl, mīṭpuk kuḻu tayārāka irukkiṟatu.} — Should the boat sink, the rescue team is ready.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for to fall apart, then the Tamil for to collapse, then say \emph{mīṭpu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{மீட்பு} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A rescue\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{இடிபாடு} (iṭipāṭu)}{இடிபாடு (iṭipāṭu)}]{\ta{இடிபாடு} (iṭipāṭu) — rubble; debris}

\label{lesson:TA-C301-itipatu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for to collapse, then the Tamil for a rescue.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{இடிபாடு}}
\textbf{\ta{இடிபாடு}} — \emph{iṭipāṭu} — \textquotedblleft{}rubble; debris\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ta{இடிபாடுகளுக்குள்} \ta{ஒரு} \ta{குழந்தை} \ta{இருந்தது}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{iṭipāṭukaḷukkuḷ oru kuḻantai iruntatu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
There was a child under the rubble.
\end{quote}

Plural: \ta{இடிபாடுகள்}, \emph{iṭipāṭukaḷ}.

Usually plural: \ta{இடிபாடுகள்}, the debris.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{இடிபாடு}} (\emph{iṭipāṭu}) is a Tamil compound built from \ta{இடி}, \textquotedblleft{}to crumble, be in ruins\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 432), and \ta{பாடு}, \textquotedblleft{}fall, ruin\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 3852).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{iṭipāṭu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{iṭipāṭu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{iṭipāṭukaḷukkuḷ oru kuḻantai iruntatu.} — There was a child under the rubble.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for to collapse, then the Tamil for a rescue, then say \emph{iṭipāṭu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{இடிபாடு} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Rubble; debris\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{விடுவி} (viṭuvi)}{விடுவி (viṭuvi)}]{\ta{விடுவி} (viṭuvi) — to set free; to free}

\label{lesson:TA-C301-vituvi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for a rescue, then the Tamil for rubble.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{விடுவி}}
\textbf{\ta{விடுவி}} — \emph{viṭuvi} — \textquotedblleft{}to set free; to free\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ta{மீட்புக்} \ta{குழு} \ta{குழந்தையைக்} \ta{கவனமாக} \ta{விடுவித்தது}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mīṭpuk kuḻu kuḻantaiyaik kavaṉamāka viṭuvittatu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The rescue team freed the child carefully.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \ta{விடுவித்தேன்}, \emph{viṭuvittēṉ}.

The causative of \ta{விடு}, to let go.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{விடுவி}} (\emph{viṭuvi}) is native Dravidian: the causative of \ta{விடு}, \textquotedblleft{}to leave, let go\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 5393).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{viṭuvi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mīṭpuk kuḻu kuḻantaiyaik kavaṉamāka viṭuvittatu.} — The rescue team freed the child carefully.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for a rescue, then the Tamil for rubble, then say \emph{viṭuvi} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை} (uyir piḻai)}{உயிர் பிழை (uyir piḻai)}]{\ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை} (uyir piḻai) — to survive}

\label{lesson:TA-C301-uyir-pilai}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for rubble, then the Tamil for to set free.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை}}
\textbf{\ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை}} — \emph{uyir piḻai} — \textquotedblleft{}to survive\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ta{அந்த} \ta{விபத்தில்} \ta{ஒருவர்} \ta{மட்டும்} \ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழைத்தார்}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{anta vipattil oruvar maṭṭum uyir piḻaittār.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Only one person survived that accident.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழைத்தேன்}, \emph{uyir piḻaittēṉ}.

\ta{பிழை} here means to escape harm; as a noun the same word is a mistake.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை}} (\emph{uyir piḻai}) joins native \ta{உயிர்}, \textquotedblleft{}life\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 645), and \ta{பிழை}, \textquotedblleft{}to escape from evil or danger\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 4186).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{uyir piḻai}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{anta vipattil oruvar maṭṭum uyir piḻaittār.} — Only one person survived that accident.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for rubble, then the Tamil for to set free, then say \emph{uyir piḻai} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{மீட்டெடு} (mīṭṭeṭu)}{மீட்டெடு (mīṭṭeṭu)}]{\ta{மீட்டெடு} (mīṭṭeṭu) — to retrieve; to pull out}

\label{lesson:TA-C301-mittetu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for to set free, then the Tamil for to survive.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{மீட்டெடு}}
\textbf{\ta{மீட்டெடு}} — \emph{mīṭṭeṭu} — \textquotedblleft{}to retrieve; to pull out\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ta{அவர்கள்} \ta{இடிபாடுகளிலிருந்து} \ta{பத்து} \ta{பேரை} \ta{மீட்டெடுத்தார்கள்}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{avarkaḷ iṭipāṭukaḷiliruntu pattu pērai mīṭṭeṭuttārkaḷ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
They pulled ten people out of the rubble.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \ta{மீட்டெடுத்தேன்}, \emph{mīṭṭeṭuttēṉ}.

What is recovered takes -\ta{ஐ}, the place -\ta{இலிருந்து}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{மீட்டெடு}} (\emph{mīṭṭeṭu}) is a Tamil compound built from \ta{மீட்டு}, \textquotedblleft{}to bring back, save\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 4883), and \ta{எடு}, \textquotedblleft{}to take up\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 851).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for to set free, then the Tamil for to survive, then say \emph{mīṭṭeṭu} again

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: witnesses, thieves and the police}

\label{lesson:TA-R301-review-294-301}



\begin{quote}
Say the Tamil for a witness and an incident.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a witness, an incident, to steal, a robbery, to happen
  \item a clue, a trace, to suspect, a crime, a culprit
  \item the police, to arrest, to cordon off, a prisoner, to confess
  \item to smuggle, to flee, a counterfeit note, an investigation, to accuse
  \item an accident, to be badly hurt, to be wrecked, to escape alive, first aid
  \item to catch fire, to blaze, to burn down, a firefighter, to suffocate
  \item an emergency, a curfew, to stall, to fall apart, to collapse
  \item a rescue, rubble, to set free, to survive, to retrieve
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A witness? (\textbf{\ta{சாட்சி}}, \emph{cāṭci}.) An incident? (\textbf{\ta{சம்பவம்}}, \emph{campavam}.) To steal? (\textbf{\ta{திருடு}}, \emph{tiruṭu}.) A robbery? (\textbf{\ta{கொள்ளை}}, \emph{koḷḷai}.) To happen? (\textbf{\ta{நிகழ்}}, \emph{nikaḻ}.) A clue? (\textbf{\ta{துப்பு}}, \emph{tuppu}.) A trace? (\textbf{\ta{தடயம்}}, \emph{taṭayam}.) To suspect? (\textbf{\ta{சந்தேகி}}, \emph{cantēki}.) A crime? (\textbf{\ta{குற்றம்}}, \emph{kuṟṟam}.) A culprit? (\textbf{\ta{குற்றவாளி}}, \emph{kuṟṟavāḷi}.) The police? (\textbf{\ta{காவல்துறை}}, \emph{kāvaltuṟai}.) To arrest? (\textbf{\ta{கைது} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{kaitu cey}.) To cordon off? (\textbf{\ta{சுற்றிவளை}}, \emph{cuṟṟivaḷai}.) A prisoner? (\textbf{\ta{கைதி}}, \emph{kaiti}.) To confess? (\textbf{\ta{ஒப்புக்கொள்}}, \emph{oppukkoḷ}.) To smuggle? (\textbf{\ta{கடத்து}}, \emph{kaṭattu}.) To flee? (\textbf{\ta{தப்பியோடு}}, \emph{tappiyōṭu}.) A counterfeit note? (\textbf{\ta{கள்ளநோட்டு}}, \emph{kaḷḷanōṭṭu}.) An investigation? (\textbf{\ta{புலனாய்வு}}, \emph{pulaṉāyvu}.) To accuse? (\textbf{\ta{குற்றஞ்சாட்டு}}, \emph{kuṟṟañcāṭṭu}.) An accident? (\textbf{\ta{விபத்து}}, \emph{vipattu}.) To be badly hurt? (\textbf{\ta{படுகாயமடை}}, \emph{paṭukāyamaṭai}.) To be wrecked? (\textbf{\ta{உருக்குலை}}, \emph{urukkulai}.) To escape alive? (\textbf{\ta{உயிர்தப்பு}}, \emph{uyirtappu}.) First aid? (\textbf{\ta{முதலுதவி}}, \emph{mutalutavi}.) To catch fire? (\textbf{\ta{தீப்பிடி}}, \emph{tīppiṭi}.) To blaze? (\textbf{\ta{பற்றியெரி}}, \emph{paṟṟiyeri}.) To burn down? (\textbf{\ta{தீக்கிரையாகு}}, \emph{tīkkiraiyāku}.) A firefighter? (\textbf{\ta{தீயணைப்பு} \ta{வீரர்}}, \emph{tīyaṇaippu vīrar}.) To suffocate? (\textbf{\ta{மூச்சுத்திணறு}}, \emph{mūccuttiṇaṟu}.) An emergency? (\textbf{\ta{அவசரநிலை}}, \emph{avacaranilai}.) A curfew? (\textbf{\ta{ஊரடங்கு}}, \emph{ūraṭaṅku}.) To stall? (\textbf{\ta{முடங்கு}}, \emph{muṭaṅku}.) To fall apart? (\textbf{\ta{நிலைகுலை}}, \emph{nilaikulai}.) To collapse? (\textbf{\ta{இடிந்துவிழு}}, \emph{iṭintuviḻu}.) A rescue? (\textbf{\ta{மீட்பு}}, \emph{mīṭpu}.) Rubble? (\textbf{\ta{இடிபாடு}}, \emph{iṭipāṭu}.) To set free? (\textbf{\ta{விடுவி}}, \emph{viṭuvi}.) To survive? (\textbf{\ta{உயிர்} \ta{பிழை}}, \emph{uyir piḻai}.) To retrieve? (\textbf{\ta{மீட்டெடு}}, \emph{mīṭṭeṭu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
